*of the Levites* is an ASV supply: the Hebrew reads only לִבְנֵי מְרָרִי הַנּוֹתָרִים. The *of* is included here because the only thing it links *rest* to is the supplied phrase, so no morpheme licenses it either (rules 7, 30).
*were given* is supplied for a verbless Hebrew clause, as in vv.61, 63 and 71 (rule 30).

review_notes: Two added units. The ASV marks only *the Levites* as supplied, but the *of* at t004 exists solely to attach that supply to *the rest*, so it joins the added unit rather than being handed to הַנּוֹתָרִים. The competing reading keeps *rest of* together and marks only t005–t006 added; I took the wider unit because *rest of* with no rectum is not a rendering of anything.

alignments.note: The contiguous compound preposition מֵעֵבֶר לְ is rendered by the single English word *beyond*, so all three morphemes share a unit, headed on the lexeme-bearing noun (rule 30).
Proper name with a supplied *the*, which the compound preposition's own unit does not carry.
The appositional genitive *Jordan of Jericho* is recast as *at Jericho*; the supplied *at* realizes this rectum's relation and belongs to it (rule 19).
מִזְרָח → *the east side*; *side* is the supplied generic noun, so the head is *east* (rule 31), and the construct takes a supplied *the* (rule 29).
*were given them* is wholly supplied, verb and indirect object alike; no morpheme in the projection licenses any of it (rule 30).
The assimilated article takes the *the* the ASV writes in *in the wilderness* (rule 12).
The name and its locative he are fused into the single English word *Jahzah*, so the two morphemes share a unit (rule 30). Rule 32 governs paragogic and cohortative he, not this.

review_notes: מֵעֵבֶר לְ is taken as a single fused unit under rule 30's compound-preposition clause; the competing reading splits the לְ off as the preposition governing *the Jordan* and marks it unrepresented, but *beyond* carries every morpheme's sense, so nothing is left over.
The he of יַהְצָה is fused with the name rather than marked unrepresented, since the ASV's *Jahzah* spells it out.
Same shape as vv.73 and 75.

alignments.note: Assimilated article with no English *the* in *in Gilead* (rules 12, 29).

review_notes: Tribe heading plus two city-and-suburbs pairs; the assimilated article before Gilead is unrepresented.
Closing pair of city-and-suburbs entries on the chapter's standard pattern.
